newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Wednesday in slow trade, after falling during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.4 yen lower at 143.5 yen.

During the day, the nearby months were pressured by views that near-term supplies will be abundant. Activity was sluggish amid a lack of fresh factors. Volume during the day was 5,596 lots. "The nearby months are likely to fall further on supply concerns," one trader said.
